business_summary: Global Vectra Helicorp Limited provides helicopter services for the oil and gas sector in India. The company engages in maintenance, repair and overhaul services. It also offers heli-pilgrimage, airborne geophysical surveys, LIDAR mapping, offshore crew change, oil and gas logistics support, geophysical missions, VIP/VVIP transportation, election flying, corporate travel, defence support, RBI operations, anti-Naxal operations, utility and infrastructure support, emergency response, charter services, underslung cargo operations, remote logistics missions, and government support services. It operates a fleet of approximately 25 helicopters. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Mumbai, India.
